The Manager now uses shared capability descriptions for OpenVINO/ONNX RIFE, NCNN/Vulkan inference, TensorRT/CUDA and Vulkan display. Provider availability and native hardware qualification remain explicit.

`AnimeJaNaiPlatform --capabilities` exposes that catalog. `--versions --root DIR [--release-manifest FILE]` separates compiled provenance, delivered manifest and installed file hashes; replaced libraries and missing metadata are reported explicitly.

Targeted Manager before/after and real-file provenance checks passed. GPU libraries retain the 3.8.0.44 pin; no FPS claim. See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-15-capabilities-versions-20261016.md). Platform assets appear as independent builds finish.
